caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with a tall, triangular handle rising from the center of the longer sides. The handle has an oval-shaped cutout near the top, likely for gripping. The box appears to be constructed from flat wooden planks, and the ends are joined together with visible small nails or rivets. The structure is relatively shallow, and the handle creates two open compartments on either side. The entire object is rendered in shades of brown, suggesting a wood texture, with visible grain and subtle highlights and shadows indicating the dimensions and contours of the surface. The box is depicted against a plain, light beige or tan background. The artist's name, Leroy Griffith, is printed in small capital letters in the lower right corner.
title: Knife Box
